Every Chemical Reactor recipe in three lanes at once, each twice as fast as a reactor, for 80% of the FE an operation.
Build a solid 3x3x3 cube of casings and set its ports with the Wrench: Input, Output, By-product, Energy and Heat.

# Lanes and tanks
- Each lane has three input slots, an output slot and a by-product slot. Items through Input ports go to the lane holding the fewest.
- The lanes share three input tanks, an output tank and a by-product tank of 32,000 mB each, so several lanes can run on the same fluids.
# Heat
Heated recipes (Polysilicon) take HU through Heat ports, and only run while the array is hot enough.
Speed and Energy upgrades work as in the reactor.
